## HueMux v0.0.2-alpha.3 — pairing works from either page

> **Alpha.** Built and tested in CI, and the changes below were exercised in a
> browser against a real bridge on Linux — but not on Windows or macOS, and not
> over a long run. For a build that has actually been used in anger, stay on
> [v0.0.1](https://github.com/zamber/huemux/releases/tag/v0.0.1).

Groundwork for hiding the tab a profile doesn't need. Bridge pairing used to
live only on the Sync page — the Lights page offered a link to it and nothing
more — which was survivable until `--profile=lights` arrived, since that
configuration has no Sync page to link to.

Pairing is now a shared component mounted by both pages, so a lights-only
install can discover and pair on its own.

### Fixes

- **Six pairing strings were never translated.** "Searching for a bridge on
  your network…", "Found a bridge:", "Pair", and others were hardcoded English
  regardless of language — including one where the translation key already
  existed and simply wasn't used. All six now have English and Polish entries.
- **Dynamic strings in the pairing panel ignored language switches.** A
  top-level `const` in a classic script is not a property of `window`, so the
  panel's `window.HueMuxI18n` guard was always false and every runtime-rendered
  string fell back to English. Static labels translated, these did not — which
  is why it survived a visual check.
- The manual-IP field now uses a 16px font, which stops iOS Safari zooming the
  viewport when you tap it.

### Unchanged

Profiles behave exactly as in
[alpha.2](https://github.com/zamber/huemux/releases/tag/v0.0.2-alpha.2): the
profile still gates the server rather than the UI, so both tabs remain visible
under every profile. Hiding them is the next phase, and it needed this one
first.

`--listen-host`, `--auth`, `--token`, and `--tls` are still parsed and
validated but inert; the server binds `127.0.0.1` only. See
[plans/03-execution-phases.md](https://github.com/zamber/huemux/blob/main/plans/03-execution-phases.md).

### For contributors

New [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/zamber/huemux/blob/main/AGENTS.md) covering
the development workflow. Most usefully: `web/` is compiled into the binary
with `go:embed`, so **editing a frontend file and reloading the browser does
nothing** until you rebuild. That failure is indistinguishable from a broken
change, and the README previously said "no build step for the frontend", which
did not help.

### Known issues

Unchanged — see
[KNOWN_ISSUES.md](https://github.com/zamber/huemux/blob/main/KNOWN_ISSUES.md).
